17:105.text: And with truth We have sent it down
, and with truth it has descended. And We have sent you
(O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم)
as nothing but a bearer of glad tidings
(of Paradise for those who follow your Message of Islâmic Monotheism)
(of Hell-fire for those who refuse to follow your Message of Islâmic Monotheism)

17:106.text: a Qur’ân which We have divided
, in order that you might recite it to men at intervals. And We have revealed it by stages

17:107.text: (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم to them)
. Verily those who were given knowledge before it
(the Jews and the Christians like ‘Abdullâh bin Salâm and Salmân Al-Farisî)
, when it is recited to them, fall down on their faces in humble prostration."

17:108.text: And they say: "Glory be to our Lord! Truly, the Promise of our Lord must be fulfilled."

17:109.text: And they fall down on their faces weeping and it increases their humility.

17:110.text: (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم)
: "Invoke Allâh or invoke the Most Gracious
, by whatever name you invoke Him
, for to Him belong the Best Names. And offer your Salât
neither aloud nor in a low voice, but follow a way between.

17:111.text: And say: "All the praises and thanks be to Allâh, Who has not begotten a son
, and Who has no partner in
Dominion, nor He is low to have a Walî
. And magnify Him with all magnificence,

18:1.text: All the praises and thanks be to Allâh, Who has sent down to His slave
, and has not placed therein any crookedness.

18:2.text: of a severe punishment from Him, and to give glad tidings to the believers
(in the Oneness of Allâh - Islâmic Monotheism)
, who do righteous deeds, that they shall have a fair reward

18:3.text: They shall abide therein for ever.

18:4.text: who say, "Allâh has begotten a son
